title: Points Earning Rate Schedule — Finch Circle Loyalty Program
content:
Base earn in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program is set per tier as points per net qualifying dollar spent at Marlowe & Finch with any tender. The bonus event invitations and their multiplier are also set per tier; rounding, posting time and the excluded purchase types are common to all tiers.

## Rates by tier

| Tier | Base points per dollar | Bonus event days per calendar year | Bonus event multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Finch Circle Member | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| Finch Circle Silver | 1 | 3 | 2 |
| Finch Circle Gold | 1.50 | 4 | 2 |
| Finch Circle Platinum | 2 | 4 | 3 |
| Finch Circle Diamond | 2.50 | 6 | 3 |
| Finch Circle Icon | 3 | 8 | 3 |

## Terms common to every tier

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| Points rounding | fractional points on one purchase line are rounded down to whole points |
| Points posting time | within 2 business days after the purchase date (in store) or the ship date (online) |
| Purchase types that earn no points and count as no qualifying spend | gift cards, sales tax, delivery fees, alteration fees, shipping fees |

## Definitions

- **Base points per dollar** — points per net qualifying dollar spent at Marlowe & Finch with any tender; a number per USD.
- **Points rounding** — how fractional points on one purchase line are handled; the rule is round down to whole points.
- **Points posting time** — business days after the purchase date (in store) or ship date (online) within which points post; a whole number.
- **Excluded purchase types** — purchase types that earn no points and count as no qualifying spend.
- **Bonus event days per calendar year** — the number of Double Points or Triple Points days the tier is invited to per calendar year.
- **Bonus event multiplier** — the multiplier applied to base points on a bonus event day.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- At Finch Circle Gold, a purchase line with 85.50 of net qualifying dollars gives 85.50 multiplied by 1.50, that is 128.25, rounded down to 128 points.
- At Finch Circle Diamond the same line gives 85.50 multiplied by 2.50, that is 213.75, rounded down to 213 points.
- A Finch Circle Platinum member's bonus event multiplier is 3 (Triple Points); a Finch Circle Silver member's is 2 (Double Points).
- A 40.00 gift card in the same basket earns nothing at any tier.
